inputs.share_count_basis: 1,194.891m shares in issue (excl. treasury) at 14 Sep 2026 per H1-2026 interim report, plus 1.676m dilutive options from the H1-2026 diluted-EPS table = 1,196.6m fully diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows (charging both would double-count). No non-SBC issuance expected; the planned A-share IPO (audit fees in FY2024) has not proceeded and is not modelled.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 Jun 2026 (H1-2026 interim, RMB'000 -> m). Debt: short-term bank borrowings 6,130.320 + long-term 0 + lease liabilities 6.971 current + 7.505 non-current = 6,144.796. Cash-like: cash & equivalents 1,854.294 + pledged bank deposits 2,069.329 (collateral for the borrowings, so netted) + fixed deposits >3m 502.690 current + 60.826 non-current + financial assets at FVTPL (bank wealth-management products / structured deposits) 2,015.526 current + 155.839 non-current + financial assets at amortised cost 526.650 current + 979.615 non-current = 8,164.769. BROAD definition, as for 9999.HK: ~3.7bn of the pile is wealth-management/structured product rather than bank cash, and the H1-2026 borrowing surge (+2.0bn net) was matched by placing 1.38bn of pledged deposits, i.e. a low-rate RMB/USD carry structure rather than operating funding. Management's 96.8% gearing ratio is gross borrowings/equity and ignores the asset side. Every income stream from these assets (interest 83.0m, FVTPL gain 37.9m in FY2025) is excluded from the operating EBITDA margin, so the assets go in the bridge at value and are not counted twice.
inputs.last_fcf_basis: NORMALISED mid-cycle owner FCF, not the FY2025 print. FY2025 reported FCF 1,543.3 (OCF 2,146.2 - capex 602.9) carries a +856.6m working-capital inflow (payables +3,155 vs receivables -1,942, inventories -371) that reversed in H1-2026 (FCF -824.8); FY2025 owner FCF ex the WC swing is 686.7 - SBC 19.9 = 666.8, earned at an above-mid-cycle 7.8% gross margin. At the 5.5% mid-cycle EBITDA margin on FY2025 revenue: EBITDA 1,148 - cash tax ~113 - capex 2.5% 522 - SBC 21 ~= 492, rounded to 500. This is the SEK.NZ peak-FCF trap the house philosophy guards against; the component build below is what the engine actually discounts.
inputs.interest_income_note: HK/IFRS presentation: interest received (36.1m FY2025) sits in INVESTING activities, so reported OCF/FCF already excludes it. P&L interest income (83.0m) and FVTPL gains (37.9m) are in 'other income' and are excluded from the forward EBITDA margin; their source assets are in net cash.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report note 28(b) cash-flow reconciliation, 'Equity-settled share-based payment expenses' RMB19,931k (FY2024: 4,426k); no equity-award tax withholding disclosed (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 all years). Essentially SBC-zero: 0.1% of revenue.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases FY2018-FY2025; FY2025 declared HKD 55 cents/share (vs 10 cents FY2024) funded largely by the Q Tech India disposal proceeds/gain -- a one-off, not a recurring yield. Flat count is a modelling convention the company has not had to fund; option dilution is ~0.14%/yr.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and all flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1727 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T12:30Z. Direction check: 1 CNY = 1.17 HKD (HKD is the weaker unit), so RMB per-share values are MULTIPLIED by 1.1727 to reach HKD; a RMB 1.00/share value reads HK$1.17. No dual listing exists for a parity check (the A-share IPO never completed); the FY2025 dividend was declared in HKD cents (55.0) against RMB accounts, consistent with HKD being the quote basis only.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' currency (CNY): China 10y government bond ~1.75% (Oct 2026) + ~6.0% China equity risk premium x beta ~1.3 for a thin-margin smartphone-component supplier = ~9.6% cost of equity, rounded up to 10.0% for HK small-cap illiquidity and the gross-debt/wealth-product carry structure. Net cash on the broad definition, so WACC ~= cost of equity; the 1.4% annualised rate on the RMB bank borrowings is not given credit. Risk is charged ONCE: the same 10% applies to all three scenarios, and cyclicality, customer concentration and the memory-chip trough are carried in the scenario paths and a 30% bear weight, not in a WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities 14.5m (0.2% of debt) included in total_debt; lease principal (7.9m FY2025, 3.7m H1-2026) NOT deducted from the flows; ongoing lease-asset renewal is inside the capex % (payments for non-current assets). Interest on leases 0.3m/half is immaterial. One treatment, applied consistently.
inputs.nci_treatment: None required: non-controlling interests are nil at 30 Jun 2026 and 31 Dec 2025 (Q Tech India was deconsolidated in Sep 2025 and is now a 48.92% equity-accounted JV). Profit for the year equals attributable profit, so NOPAT ties to attributable income without a leakage driver.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (scenario-weighted), routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' with the adaptations file (currency, leases, NCI, matching-asset rule, SBC-near-zero, charge-risk-once). First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. BASE YEAR: FY2025 revenue 20,876.5 is the compounding base, but FY2025 earnings are NOT a clean base -- profit from operations 1,739.4 exceeds gross profit 1,618.4 because 'other income' of 992.5 holds the RMB856.8m pre-tax (811.6m post-tax) gain on selling 51.08% of Q Tech India to Dixon. Recurring operating EBITDA = gross profit 1,618.4 - S&D 43.3 - admin 172.5 - R&D 655.8 + government grants 68.2 + VAT input-credit 42.1 + D&A 438.9 = ~1,296 = 6.2% of revenue (FY2024: ~860 = 5.3%; H1-2026: ~474 = 4.8%; cycle FY2021-25 ~4.0% trough to ~7.5% peak). FX/derivative hedging items (-81.6m FY2025, +96.6m FY2024) net to ~zero across the cycle and are excluded; interest, FVTPL gains and JV/associate share are excluded with their assets in the bridge. The 5% advanced-manufacturing VAT credit (42m) sunsets 31 Dec 2027, which is why the margin path does not credit the full 6.2%. CYCLE: management frames FY2026 as the trough (H1-2026 GM 6.6% vs 7.4%, ASP -14%, China H2 shipments guided ~-20%), DRAM/NAND shortage persisting into 2027, no replacement-cycle recovery before 2028-29; the base path has revenue +4%/+2% and EBITDA margin 4.7%/4.5% for FY2026-27 before recovering to 5.5% mid-cycle by FY2031. WORKING CAPITAL: receivables 5,775 + inventories 2,017 - payables 7,251 = 541 net (2.6% of revenue) -- a stretched-payables manufacturer, so wc_capture is -3% (growth consumes cash; a decline releases it). TERMINAL: cap 12x FCF for a cyclical (house 12-15x band, low end for 57% top-3 customer concentration). STREET/HOUSE: SBC is 0.1% of revenue, so the band is effectively collapsed; band_position is reported but is not a meaningful finding.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case 10-year average revenue growth (4.5%), bracketed by the 5yr revenue CAGR (3.7%) and the ex-gain 5yr equity CAGR (8.2%); the 3yr figures start from the FY2022 trough and overstate the trend
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 11.1% (8.2% ex the FY2025 India gain) diverges >30% from revenue 5yr 3.7% and underlying EPS 5yr -4.4%: book compounds via retained earnings and the one-off gain while per-share earnings have not grown since the FY2020-21 peak. EPS CAGRs use underlying FY2025 EPS of RMB0.571 (1,493.6m - 811.6m gain) / 1,193.6m diluted, not the reported 1.251.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC (interest received is in investing under HK presentation, so no interest adjustment): FY2020 3,032.9 / FY2021 661.7 / FY2022 640.8 / FY2023 -515.1 / FY2024 723.1 / FY2025 1,523.4. The series is dominated by working-capital swings (FY2025 +857m, H1-2026 reversal), so neither FCF CAGR is a usable growth signal; the normalised mid-cycle base (~500) is what the drivers compound from. SBC is immaterial (max 0.2% of revenue) so the owner and reported CAGRs are the same.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +4%: H1 was +12.4% on volume/non-handset mix with ASP -14%, H2 faces China shipments ~-20% and the Q Tech India deconsolidation; FY2027 +2% with the chip shortage persisting; FY2028-30 +7/+7/+6% on the 2028-29 replacement cycle plus non-handset (auto/IoT) growing >30%/yr off 27% of camera revenue; fading to 3% by FY2034.
base.margin_rationale: 4.7%/4.5% FY2026-27 trough (H1-2026 ran 4.8% before the H2 cost squeeze), recovering to the 5.5% mid-cycle by FY2031 as utilisation and non-handset mix normalise; below the FY2025 6.2% because that year had 7.8% GM and the VAT credit (0.2%) sunsets end-2027.
base.tax_rationale: PRC high-tech enterprise rate 15% (underlying FY2025 ETR 15.3% ex the disposal gain; H1-2026 11.6%), ramping to 18% to carry 5-10% withholding tax on dividends repatriated to the HK/Cayman parent now that payouts have resumed.
base.capex_rationale: FY2025 capex 2.9% (603m) after three years at 1.1-1.5% (below D&A); the automotive/IoT buildout keeps it at 2.6-2.8% near term then 2.5% mature, with D&A (2.1% FY2025) converging up toward 2.4%.

bull.narrative: Memory-chip shock proves cyclical (eases during 2027); non-handset reaches the 50% of camera revenue target by 2030 with automotive top-3; mature EBITDA 6.5% (FY2025 6.2% held and improved on mix, still below the 7.5% FY2021 peak).

bear.narrative: A top-3 customer (each >10% of revenue, three together 57%) re-sources or the China downturn deepens: FY2027 revenue -12%, EBITDA margin at the FY2022-23 trough (3.6-4.0%) and never above 4.3%; growth thereafter only at RMB inflation; VAT credit lapses.

scenario_narratives.base: Smartphone trough through FY2027 as management guides -- DRAM/NAND costs squeeze OEM volumes (China H2-2026 ~-20%) and push the mid/high-end mix down, holding Q Tech's EBITDA margin at 4.5-4.7% on revenue growth of 2-4%. From FY2028 the replacement cycle returns and non-handset (automotive ADAS/LiDAR, AI glasses, drones, handheld imaging, +50%/yr guided) lifts both growth (6-7%) and utilisation, taking the margin back to the 5.5% mid-cycle by FY2031; growth then fades to 3%. Capex runs 2.5-2.8% to fund the non-handset lines; cash tax ramps 15% -> 18% as dividend withholding resumes. The broad net cash (RMB 2.0bn incl. pledged deposits and wealth products) and the JV/associate stakes are added at book. Value is roughly half operations and half balance sheet.
scenario_narratives.bull: The memory-chip shortage eases during 2027, Chinese OEMs restock and the 2028-29 upgrade cycle arrives early; periscope/OIS/200MP mix migrates to mid-tier phones, lifting ASP. Non-handset revenue reaches 50% of camera revenue by 2030 with a top-3 automotive position, and the Newmax/poLight integration shaves lens/actuator cost. EBITDA margin climbs to 6.5% (above FY2025's 6.2%, below the FY2021 7.5% peak) on 8-10% growth in FY2028-30. Terminal growth 3.0%, still capped at 12x FCF.
scenario_narratives.bear: One of the three >10% customers moves volume to Sunny Optical or an in-house supplier, or the China smartphone decline runs into 2028: FY2027 revenue -12% with no rebound, utilisation falls and the EBITDA margin sits at the FY2022-23 trough (3.6-4.0%), settling at 4.3%. The VAT credit lapses, R&D cannot be cut below ~3.5% of revenue, and growth thereafter is 2.5% nominal. The company stays solvent (broad net cash) but the operation earns barely above its cost of capital. This path is above the house zero-floor but the terminal FCF margin is ~1.5%, so terminal value is only ~4x revenue-years of cash.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: three customers each exceed 10% of revenue (57% combined) and management itself guides a trough lasting into 2027 with no recovery before 2028-29, so the downside path needs only one of those to go wrong. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things -- an early chip-cost reversal, the non-handset 50% target on schedule, and a mix-driven margin above FY2025 -- in a business whose R&D intensity trails the sector leader. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC is 0.1% of revenue, so the house and street bases coincide (street IV exceeds house IV by ~3%); the band has collapsed to a point and band_position is not a meaningful finding. The engine's arithmetic value (-1385) is the price sitting far below both ends of a 30-cent band, not an SBC-regime reading.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the operating business on a mid-cycle owner-FCF margin, never on FY2025's one-off-inflated profit or its working-capital-flattered FCF, and add the broad net cash and equity-accounted stakes once at book with their income stripped from the flows. The three scenarios carry the cycle, the customer concentration and the memory-chip trough; the discount rate carries only the currency and the asset class. A 12x FCF terminal cap stops Gordon growth from paying a compounder multiple for a 5% EBITDA-margin contract manufacturer.
key_risks_to_valuation: Customer concentration: three customers each >10% of revenue, 57% combined; loss of one is the bear case and the model gives it 30% weight.

Net cash quality: ~RMB3.7bn of the RMB8.2bn cash-like pile is bank wealth-management/structured product and RMB2.1bn is pledged against the RMB6.1bn of short-term borrowings; if the products were illiquid or the carry structure unwound at a loss, up to HK$2.8/share of bridge value would be at risk.

Margin trough deeper or longer than modelled: every 1pp of mature EBITDA margin is worth roughly HK$1.3-1.5/share; management expects the DRAM/NAND squeeze to intensify in H2-2026 and persist into 2027.
FX: RMB flows converted at CNY/HKD 1.1727; the HKD peg to USD means a 5% RMB devaluation moves every per-share figure 5%; refresh_price.py does not refresh fx_rate.
Q Tech India JV: Indian tax dispute (RMB148.9m provisions, new assessment orders Jan 2026) and INR exposure sit in a 48.92% stake carried at RMB380m book.
VAT input-credit (RMB42m/yr, 0.2% margin) sunsets 31 Dec 2027 and government grants (RMB68m) are discretionary; both are inside the modelled margin path.
